buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar

proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C DISTRICT MAGISTRATE BAHRAICH . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Human Resource Service Continuity of resources deployed by Service Provider: Successful Service provider will ensure continuity of any allocated / deployed resources with the prior consent of the buyer department. Deployed resources cannot be replaced by Service Provider without prior approval of buyer. Any replacement will also be provided through Sewayojan Portal only. 6. Human Resource Service Deployment of Existing working / deployed resources: 10 number of Existing working / deployed resources of the procurement department having job satisfactory certificate, will be continued by the successful Service Provider under the new contract also – subject to their consent to the Terms and conditions of new contract concluded on the basis of this bid. 7. Human Resource Service Recruitment mandated through Sewayojan Portal: Recruitment of candidates is mandated through Sewayojan Portal (url:www.sewayojan.up.nic.in). Successful bidder / Service Provider has to select candidates registered on the Sewayojan Portal only for deployment under this contract. As such successful Service provider will have to make available adequate number of candidates / resources registered on sewayojan portal for selection / short listings by the Buyer department For 1 employee selection five times and for 2 or more than 2 employees to be three times, subject to the min of 10 candidates. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders shall carefully read the tender document and shall upload the following documents/declarations al ong with their bid. Non-submission of any mandatory document may lead to rejection of the bid. 1. EMD The bidder shall upload an FDR to be submitted online and a hard copy of the same to be deposited in the office within 3 days of Bid submission end date. 2. Integrity Pact The bidder shall upload a duly signed and stamped Integrity Pact in the standard format. 3. Financial Standing Undertaking The bidder shall submit an undertaking/declaration confirming that: The firm is financially sound and solvent.

No court receiver has been appointed over the firm/business. The firm is not bankrupt, insolvent, or under liquidation proceedings. 4. Declaration Regarding Land Border Sharing Countries The bidder shall submit an undertaking/declaration regarding compliance with Government of India restric tions on procurement from bidders belonging to countries sharing a land border with India, as applicable u nder prevailing Government orders. 5. Mandatory Corporate and Compliance Declarations The bidder shall upload duly signed declarations/undertakings covering the following: (a) Technology Transfer & Skill Development Commitment A declaration confirming commitment towards technology transfer and skill development initiatives, where ver applicable. (b) Sustainability & Environmental Responsibility Pledge A declaration affirming commitment towards sustainable business practices and environmental protection. (c) Local Economic Integration Commitment A declaration confirming support for local sourcing, local employment generation, and economic integratio n. (d) Cyber Security & Data Protection Undertaking A declaration confirming adherence to applicable cyber security standards and protection of confidential in formation and data. (e) Comprehensive Risk Management Declaration A declaration affirming implementation of appropriate risk management systems and practices. (f) Transparency & Accountability Protocol Declaration A declaration confirming compliance with principles of transparency, ethical conduct, accountability, and f air business practices. (g) Social Responsibility Commitment A declaration regarding commitment towards social responsibility and responsible business conduct. (h) Legal & Regulatory Compliance Undertaking A declaration confirming compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, statutory requirements, and gov ernment directives. 6. ISO Certifications The bidder shall possess and upload valid copies of the following certifications to be issued before bid publi shing date: ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management System ISO 45001:2018 – Occupational Health & Safety Management System SA 8000:2014 – Human Resource Management / Recruitment Guidelines (or latest applicable version) 7. Self-Certification of Documents All documents uploaded with the bid shall be: Signed by the authorized signatory; Stamped with the firm's seal (where applicable); and

Self-certified as true copies of the original documents. 8. Authenticity of Documents The bidder shall be solely responsible for the correctness and authenticity of all information and document s submitted. Any false, misleading, forged, or fabricated document may result in rejection of the bid and fu rther action as per tender conditions. 9. Compliance with Tender Conditions The bidder shall comply with all terms, conditions, specifications, eligibility criteria, and requirements ment ioned in: Tender Document, Special Conditions of Contract (SCC), Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC), Corrigenda/Addenda, if any. 10. Rejection of Bid The bid shall be liable for rejection if: Any mandatory document is not uploaded; Any required declaration/undertaking is not furnished; Any document is unsigned or improperly executed; Any information furnished is found incorrect or misleading; or Any provision of the tender document, ATC, or applicable procurement guidelines is not complied with. 11. Bidder's Responsibility Submission of a bid shall be deemed as confirmation that the bidder has: Read and understood the complete tender document; Accepted all terms and conditions without reservation; Examined all requirements, specifications, and obligations under the contract; and Agreed to execute the work/supply in accordance with the tender conditions.
